title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: All domains: time management, numbers to memorize, look-alike terms and decision rules
Apply a repeatable method to every question; recall the limits, roles and portal paths of all three domains; separate look-alike features
the official Microsoft SC-200 study guide (skills measured as of October 21, 2026) and Microsoft Learn

html:
1Time and technique

Item Advice
Time 100 minutes; move on from a question that stalls and mark it for review
Case studies and interactive items Read the requirements first, then the details; answers must meet every stated requirement
Least effort Prefer the built-in role, the existing connector and the automation rule over custom builds
Least privilege Pick the lowest role that does the job, at the narrowest scope
Portal Use Defender portal paths; Sentinel leaves the Azure portal after March 31, 2027
Blanks Never leave one; answer everything
Exam tip

. Three words decide most questions: which product, which role, which table. Name them before you read the options.

Pair Difference

Soft delete and Hard delete Soft = Recoverable Items; hard = purged
Real-time detections and Threat Explorer Plan 1 and Plan 2
Audit Standard and Premium 180 days and one year (10 with add-on)
Analytics tier and Data lake tier Detections and workbooks and cheap long-term storage
KQL job and Summary rule Lake to Analytics and aggregate to a _CL table
Automation rule and Playbook No-code, fast and Logic App, external actions
Custom detection rule and Analytics rule Defender XDR data and Sentinel data
User risk and Sign-in risk Password change and MFA
Disable and Mark as compromised AD account and Entra only
SecurityEvent and WindowsEvent Security Events via AMA and Windows Forwarded Events
Syslog and CommonSecurityLog Syslog via AMA and CEF via AMA
has and contains Whole term, fast and substring, slow
Timestamp and TimeGenerated Defender XDR tables and Sentinel tables

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A SOC wants one place to approve pending remediation actions of all kinds. Where should an analyst go?

  • ASettings > Endpoints > Rules > Alert suppression
  • BMicrosoft Sentinel > Configuration > Automation
  • CAssets > Identities > Identity inventory
  • DActions & submissions > Action center > Pending
Show the answer

Answer: D. The Action center Pending tab holds actions that wait for approval.

S2A team must keep authentication logs for eight years at the lowest cost and does not need detections on them. Which setting fits?

  • AAnalytics tier with two years of analytics retention
  • BXDR default tier extended to 90 days of retention
  • CBasic logs with a summary rule on every table
  • DData lake tier with eight years of retention
Show the answer

Answer: D. The Data lake tier keeps data up to 12 years at low cost; detections need the Analytics tier.

S3A user risk is High because of leaked credentials. Which automatic remediation should be configured?

  • AA sign-in risk policy that requires MFA only
  • BA Defender for Identity alert tuning rule
  • CA user risk policy that requires a password change
  • DA Defender for Cloud Apps session policy
Show the answer

Answer: C. User risk is fixed by a password change; sign-in risk by MFA.

S4A hunter needs to know which devices contacted a bad IP and did not already raise an alert. Which operator pattern fits?

  • AA join of kind inner with the alert table
  • BA union of the network and alert tables
  • CA summarize with make_set on the device name
  • DA join of kind leftanti with the alert table
Show the answer

Answer: D. leftanti returns left rows with no match on the right.

S5An engineer wants to collect only logons from servers outside Azure into Sentinel with the least cost. What should be used?

  • AA Syslog forwarder with a CEF connector on each server
  • BA KQL job that reads the security log of each server
  • CAzure Arc, Windows Security Events via AMA and a Custom XPath rule
  • DThe legacy agent with the All events collection option
Show the answer

Answer: C. Azure Arc enables AMA on non-Azure servers, and custom XPath collects only the wanted events.

S6An analyst needs a malicious email removed from 40 mailboxes but a user may need to recover it. Which approach fits?

  • AHardDelete through search and purge
  • BSoftDelete through Threat Explorer or search and purge
  • CAdding the sender to the Tenant Allow/Block List
  • DIsolating the mailbox servers with Defender for Endpoint
Show the answer

Answer: B. SoftDelete moves messages to Recoverable Items where they can be recovered.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What is the largest domain?

Show the answer

Manage a security operations environment, 40 to 45 percent.

R2Which table holds Windows forwarded events?

Show the answer

WindowsEvent.

R3What is the maximum total retention in Sentinel?

Show the answer

12 years.

R4Which role approves device remediation?

Show the answer

Active remediation actions (or Response manage).

R5How many rows can advanced hunting return?

Show the answer

100,000.

R6Which action contains a device from other devices?

Show the answer

Contain device.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Method product, role, table; least effort, least privilege
Portal Defender portal; Sentinel leaves Azure after March 31, 2027
Limits 7 days pending, 15,000 indicators, 150 alerts per run, 100,000 rows, 5 KQL jobs
Look-alikes isolate vs contain, soft vs hard, Plan 1 vs Plan 2, KQL job vs summary rule
Paths Settings > Endpoints; Sentinel > Configuration; Action center
